# Tatton Projects

> Tatton Projects (Tatton Project Management Ltd) is an owner-managed construction contractor based in Altrincham, Cheshire. It delivers commercial fit-out and refurbishment UK-wide, and new build homes, housing developments and major home extensions across Greater Manchester and Cheshire. 110+ projects and £8m delivered since 2020. Minimum project value £100,000.

- Owner-managed: the person who priced the job is the person managing it on site. Founded in 2020 by Dave Groom (founder and contracts manager).
- Builds around live operations: care homes, hotels, surgeries, restaurants, shops and occupied offices that stay open during the works.
- Accreditations and memberships: Federation of Master Builders, Constructionline Gold, CITB, CSCS.
- Areas: Manchester, Altrincham, Hale, Bowdon, Knutsford, Wilmslow, Alderley Edge, Sale, Stockport, Macclesfield, Chester and the rest of Greater Manchester and Cheshire; commercial fit-out and refurbishment anywhere in the UK.
- Contact: 0161 706 2907 · info@tattonprojects.co.uk · Suite 15, Peel House, 30 The Downs, Altrincham WA14 2PX
- Company no. 14163724, a Tatton Holdings company.

## Services

- [Office fit-out, Manchester](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/office-fit-out-manchester): Cat A and Cat B office fit-out across Manchester and the North West, with selected projects nationwide.
- [Shopfitting, Manchester](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/shopfitting-manchester): Retail fit-out and shopfitting, from strip-out and enabling works to a finished, trading store.
- [Commercial refurbishment, Manchester](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/commercial-refurbishment-manchester): Refurbishment of workplaces and commercial property, including EPC and MEES upgrades for landlords.
- [New build homes, Cheshire](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/new-build-homes-cheshire): One-off new build houses from £400k to £3m+, across Cheshire and Greater Manchester.
- [Extension builders, Altrincham](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/extension-builders-altrincham): Major extensions and whole-house remodels above £100,000 in Altrincham, Hale, Bowdon and Cheshire.
- [Extension builders, Hale](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/extension-builders-hale): Substantial home extensions and whole-house remodelling in Hale.
- [Housing developments and land, Cheshire](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/housing-developments-cheshire): Small and medium schemes of two to thirty plots, with or without planning consent. Tatton also buys sites and joint-ventures with landowners, with a free site appraisal in five working days.
- [All services](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/services)

## Projects

- [Vanguard, Manchester](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/work/vanguard): £2M Cat B fit-out across multiple floors, delivered to a fixed programme in a live building (2024).
- [Stockport service centre](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/work/stockport-service-centre): £175K fit-out of a public-facing service floor with ninety-plus staffed positions that never closed for a day (2025).
- [Sentric Music, Liverpool](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/work/sentric-music): £110K Cat B fit-out for a music rights business (2024).
- [Office fit-out, Stockport](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/work/stockport-office): £125K office fit-out with a frameless glass boardroom and double-height stair.
- [Wilmslow house](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/work/wilmslow-house): £375K rear extension and complete refurbishment of a 1930s detached house.
- [Knutsford new build](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/work/knutsford-new-build): £400K new build family home, from empty plot to completion.
- [Didsbury extension](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/work/didsbury-extension): £160K rear extension, kitchen and staircase.
- [Didsbury kitchen extension](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/work/didsbury-kitchen): £120K kitchen extension under a fully glazed roof.
- [Pendrick Self Storage](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/work/pendrick-self-storage): £115K steel-frame self-storage facility, from bare site to trading unit.
- [All projects](https://www.tatton-projects.co.uk/work)
